title: SkyeMusicNexus NeoFront
note: Rebuilt into a roomed NeoFront music platform while preserving the local SkyGate, artist, release, studio project, asset upload, payment, analytics, exchange, social connector, playback, rights-vault, takedown-hold, and smoke-proof runtime. Free99 applies only to Lite; the May 2026 founding-core artist grant is invite-only and no-charge for selected core artists. Paid checkout does not create live distributor, owned hosted DAW, DSP, payment, legal, label, identity-provider, Relay13 worker bridge, transcoding, native ActivityPub server, or deployed provider claims until separate provider proof exists.
commercial_state: SkyeMusicNexus Lite is Free99/no charge and gate-session required; selected May 2026 founding-core artists receive a no-charge custom artist build plus up to five launch songs packaged into their surfaces while they help promote and test the platform; Artist Host, Artist Collective, Managed Music Ops, drop add-ons, content request add-ons, and community campaign add-ons stay low-cost and still gate-session required.
identity_state: Skye-ID generator drafts now publish skye0s.identity.current.v1 with artist Skye ID and profile photo data. MusicNexus can consume that shared browser identity during gated artist registration, use the Skye ID as the artist node id, and persist the profile photo on the artist record.
creation_state: Create Hub is wired at public/create.html as the BandLab plus Spotify plus Instagram command layer. Native DAW is wired at public/daw.html with first-party Nexus code in public/nexus-daw.js and public/nexus-daw.css. It exposes transport, BPM/key controls, arrangement timeline, track controls, clip import/decode/preview, mixer, drum pads, synth keys, physical computer keyboard mapping, region select/split/duplicate/delete/quantize, undo/redo, metronome, loop toggle, local loop-pack insertion, browser microphone recording path, Web MIDI connection path, browser WAV mixdown export, project save, and release manifest export. Third-party DAW vendor source and iframe bridges have been removed from this Nexus folder. Stem Vault, Export Forge, Discover, and Feed are split into public/stems.html, public/exports.html, public/discover.html, and public/feed.html with gated studio project saves, export manifest queueing, Release Forge handoff output, community posts, open social provider queues, and netlify/functions/music-studio.js plus netlify/functions/music-social.js protected by the same SkyGate session boundary.
upload_state: Gated upload/list/stream/delete/report-upload-failure actions exist in netlify/functions/music-assets.js. The browser Upload Studio can attach returned stream URLs to release tracks, and the Music Player fetches uploaded audio through authenticated SkyGate fetch before playback. The asset handler defaults to local proof storage and can use SkyeVault/Cloudflare R2 when MUSIC_NEXUS_STORAGE_BACKEND=r2 or MUSIC_NEXUS_USE_R2=1 is configured. Direct R2 upload sessions and completion are wired behind SkyGate and activate only when MUSIC_NEXUS_ENABLE_DIRECT_UPLOAD=1. When an upload fails, the gated fallback route records a failure receipt and can email the configured founder/admin recipients through Resend with an attachment when the file is under the configured limit.
fan_access_state: Artist releases can be packaged as real fan-facing release objects with preview playback and a gated/private full-song or package access path. If an artist wants a fan to pay for a full song/package, the buyer must be able to preview what they are getting first, and the full asset must use a gated stream route, signed R2/SkyeVault URL, or private package download rather than an unlisted static file.
provider_hook_state: Gated music-provider-hooks.js queues future transcoding, waveform, CDN, DSP, legal review, and royalty settlement jobs. Provider webhooks stay disabled until explicit env flags and URLs are configured.
exchange_state: Content requests, Relay13-ready inbox threads, community posts, achievement progression, release campaign packs, and playback stream telemetry are local gated proof features.
social_state: Gated music-social.js stores Pixelfed, Mastodon-compatible, Funkwhale, and ActivityPub connector metadata, queues release posts with ActivityPub-style previews, syncs public/tag timelines for compatible Fediverse servers, and publishes through provider APIs only when a server-side token environment variable is configured. Provider tokens are not stored in browser code or local JSON.
legal_safe_state: Linked preview playback requires ownership and preview-use attestation; release publish, stream reporting, and operations queueing require the distribution rights gate; takedown requests place a playback hold. This is product control proof, not formal legal advice or a production DMCA-agent operation.
